🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive (Sector Strength); Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology). Risk and Cycle signals are N/A; the 1W/1M sector split and mixed major-stock trends confirm a transitional, not directional, tape.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: ISRG (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +13.21%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%) ABOVE TREND. Energy follows, with CVX (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +13.40%) and XOM (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +12.99%) ABOVE TREND; Materials is positive, led by DOW (1W: +8.95% | 1M: +14.18%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication is weakest: TMUS (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -11.38%) and T (1W: -10.71% | 1M: -16.83%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary and Industrials also lag on the week; GM (1W: -9.58% | 1M: -5.77%) and GE (1W: -8.98% | 1M: -10.54%) are BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.40%) RECOVERY, LMT (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.67%) ABOVE TREND, and DOW (1W: +8.95% | 1M: +14.18%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology); PANW is a short-term rebound, not a confirmed monthly trend.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: F (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -7.94%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -7.80% | 1M: +1.61%) CORRECTION, AMAT (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -20.46%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -11.38%) BELOW TREND, and NEM (1W: -8.20% | 1M: -10.25%) BELOW TREND. Weakness spans several sectors, with technology and communications among the pressure points.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.40%) RECOVERY, and LMT (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND. PANW’s weekly surge against a negative month is a divergence; monitor for follow-through.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: the sector gained 0.69% over 1W but lost 0.95% over 1M. NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) and IBM (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.67%) are ABOVE TREND, while NVDA (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.06%) and META (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -17.36%) are BELOW TREND; constituent positive-count data was not supplied.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials were nearly flat for the week (+0.02%) but positive over the month (+1.37%), with mixed stock signals. V (1W: +1.32% | 1M: +10.85%) and MA (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +10.33%) are ABOVE TREND, while JPM (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -1.57%) is BELOW TREND; constituent positive-count data was not supplied.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare leads sectors on the week (+1.44%) and is positive over the month (+5.89%). ISRG (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +13.21%), UNH (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%), LLY (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +7.75%), and PFE (1W: +1.52% | 1M: +5.70%) are ABOVE TREND; constituent positive-count data was not supplied.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor select strength rather than a broad style bet: ADBE (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +10.42%) and NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) are ABOVE TREND, while NVDA (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.06%) and META (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -17.36%) are BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; narrow top-performer concentration and major-stock divergences argue for selectivity.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH setups: ADBE (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +10.42%) ABOVE TREND if guidance-driven strength persists; UNH (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%) ABOVE TREND if earnings momentum holds. BEARISH risk: META (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -17.36%) and AMAT (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -20.46%), both BELOW TREND, if selling pressure continues.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (+1.44% 1W, +5.89% 1M) and Energy (+0.93% 1W, +11.03% 1M), both positive across timeframes. BEARISH: Communication (-2.23% 1W, -3.71% 1M) and Industrials (-0.05% 1W, -0.05% 1M); overall breadth remains 8/11 positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Price-level data was not supplied, so monitor return-based trend triggers: NVDA (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.06%) BELOW TREND and META (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -17.36%) BELOW TREND need trend stabilization. NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND and PANW (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.40%) RECOVERY are momentum tests; PANW needs monthly follow-through.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ADBE (+80): record quarter and raised guidance; ADBE (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +10.42%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. GM (+80): announced a $20 billion buyback; GM (1W: -9.58% | 1M: -5.77%) BELOW TREND, a notable price/news divergence. UNH (+60): beat-and-raise quarter; UNH (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed; LMT (+50): analyst upgrade; LMT (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND, also confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CAT (-45): price-target cut; CAT (1W: -5.99% | 1M: -14.68%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. HD (-45): price-target cut; HD (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +9.46%) ABOVE TREND, diverging from the negative news. GE (-40): target reduction; GE (1W: -8.98% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, with 8/11 sectors positive and no clear Growth-versus-Value leadership; top-five leadership remains Narrow (3/5 Technology). NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) and LMT (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +15.37%) are ABOVE TREND and showing relative strength. Monitor major-stock trend divergences and GM’s (1W: -9.58% | 1M: -5.77%) BELOW TREND price action despite strong buyback sentiment.
